about: Cowansville is a city in Quebec’s Eastern Townships (Estrie), in Brome-Missisquoi near the Vermont border approaches. A bilingual townships heritage, a compact downtown, and nearby lake and farm country shape a regional service centre. Highways 104 and 139 meet in the city. About 15,000 people live in Cowansville.
seoSummary: Eastern Townships city in Brome-Missisquoi—bilingual service hub near lakes and Vermont approaches.
knownFor: Gateway to Township lakes and farm country
